items.prompt: An optimizer reports a small root residual around an approximate integral. What would you check before asserting a root-location tolerance?
items.modelAnswer: Check continuity/uniqueness assumptions, actual bracket and reliable signs, inner integration error and whether estimated or certified, location/residual units and conditioning, actual stop status/budgets, and floating stagnation.

criteria.text: Checks bracket/status rather than trusting a requested tolerance.
